key_idea: Add the front flower, double it, then see what the back flower is missing.
steps: The green flower has all 4 petals: 9 + 4 + 6 + 5 = 24. It is the front flower.
The pink flower is missing a petal, so it is the back flower. It must add up to 24 + 24 = 48.
The pink petals we can see: 7 + 10 + 11 = 28.

choice_feedback.A: Then the pink flower adds up to 40, not 48.
choice_feedback.B: Then the pink flower adds up to 44, not 48.
choice_feedback.D: Then the pink flower adds up to 52, not 48.
choice_feedback.E: Then the pink flower adds up to 56, not 48.

review.note: The two flowers do not overlap, so nothing actually hides a petal; the pink flower just has a gap. The back flower can only be told apart by its missing petal. Key C (20) follows from that reading; redraw so the green flower covers the pink flower's fourth petal.
